## What changed

Describe the user problem and the smallest change that addresses it.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `cd backend && pytest`
- [ ] UI changes include a screenshot or recording

## Safety and truthfulness

- [ ] No secrets, private recordings, transcripts, or real health data were added
- [ ] New actions require explicit confirmation
- [ ] Simulated, integration-ready, and physically tested behavior is labeled accurately
- [ ] Health, relationship, and route claims retain uncertainty language
